resource.description: Live board totals and the signed public root, free: the axis totals and Merkle root, served through a real x402 settle. It reads nothing new: the totals are the board's own and the root is the published one. States: each axis MEASURED or UNMEASURED exactly as the board states it. Verification is free forever; the same bytes answer 200 at /api/gspc and /root.json.

queryParams.description: This door takes no query parameters. An unpaid GET answers the zero-amount 402.

totals.description: /api/gspc totals read live at request time; null when that read failed

signature.description: JWS compact serialization containing the offer payload

csoai.why_402: A zero-amount 402 so the x402 Bazaar can index this rail (it catalogues only resources that settle). Nothing is charged. The same content answers 200 with no handshake at free_equivalents.
csoai.deliverable: the Bazaar door itself: this resource is free and settles for zero. It exists so an index can discover the rail; it sells nothing and a settlement here buys nothing.

offer_receipt.verify: base64url-decode the JWS payload part, fetch https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json, take the publicKeyJwk.x of the verificationMethod whose id equals the header kid, and verify Ed25519 over `header.payload`. POST the compact string to /api/receipts/verify to have us do it, or run the same-site https://councilof.ai/verifier/verify_receipt.py checker. Default mode reads the public DID document; saved-key replay can be offline. Signature validity is not proof of settlement.
